DISTANCE & TIME / estimates, not playtest results
150 ÷ 5.8 m/s + 8–18 s obstacle / queue allowance. 34–44 s movement; staying ahead of syrup sets the round
250 ÷ 6 m/s + 6–12 s obstacle / queue allowance. Longer but avoids an overloaded upper lane.
Jump envelope: g = 20 m/s²; vᵧ = 7.5 m/s → apex 1.41 m; flight 0.75 s; 6.00 m at 8 m/s. No mandatory gap jump; use the
drawn continuous lanes. Avoid jumping under overhead hazards. Height sections and map rules govern falls.
60 spots are drawn at true bean diameter 0.8 m. Collider sizes and movement sweeps are in metres. All controls,
timings, friction, grouping and respawn rules are proposed Level-panel data.
Kill height starts -2 m; rises 0.10 m/s after 10 s. Touch = OUT.
Deck at +0 m; use continuous ramps, never mandatory high jumps.
10 m wide; +3 m per leg. Two independent lanes prevent a 60-bean
6 m sweep; 2 m clear passing shoulder.
6 m cross-bridge at +3 m; switch away from the crowded ascent.
Shows time until each terrace is submerged; no checkpoint pads.
Terrace · Final climb · Climb hammer · Sinking top segment
At 100 s flash 4 s, then sink. Two 8 m segments are the only top
crosswalks; no static deck underneath. Choose your island early.
23 m horizontal / +3 m; both approaches reach top terrace.
Arrows = travel. Hazard outlines show motion reach, not solid floor.
Elimination: syrup contact or fall below active surface = OUT. A
dry lower terrace can catch a fall; no CP / respawn. 90–120 s
target, quota stop; survival tie policy applies.
